summary: Retested Packing List PDF weight fallback fix in /app/frontend/src/utils/packing-list-pdf.ts. Logged in as kishan via 'Quick login as Kishan Sir (demo)', navigated to both target shipments, tapped [data-testid=packing-list-btn], intercepted window.open to capture the generated HTML, and asserted the totals + party rows. Both shipments now render the shipment.weight_kg fallback correctly. No new console errors introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: packing-list-pdf.ts fallback logic is clean: only triggers when totalWeight === 0 AND shipment.weight_kg > 0, then either assigns full shipment weight to the single group or splits proportionally by bag count across multi-group. Guards against divide-by-zero via 'totalBags > 0' check. Formatting via fmtWeight(w) keeps 3-decimal invariant. LGTM.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded shipments AURA-DEL-001 and AURA-DEL-002.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Packing List popup opens in a new window via window.open(''). To capture the HTML without an actual popup, override window.open before clicking [data-testid=packing-list-btn]: `window.open = () => ({ document: { _buffer:'', write(s){this._buffer+=s;}, close(){window.__capturedHtml=this._buffer;} }, focus(){}, print(){} });`. Then read `window.__capturedHtml` after ~2s.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: buildPackingListHtml aggregated totalWeight by summing bag.weight_kg across bags in each group. For legacy shipments where the weight was captured only on the shipment (shipment.weight_kg=18) and never per-bag (bag.weight_kg=0), the totals cell fell to fmtWeight(0)=0.000. Fix (lines 84–92 of packing-list-pdf.ts): after aggregation, if totalWeight===0 && Number(shipment.weight_kg) > 0, overwrite totalWeight=shipWeight and either (a) single-group: g.weight = shipWeight, or (b) multi-group with totalBags > 0: proportional split by g.nums.length/totalBags. Verified below.

verification_evidence.console_errors_new: None. The 5 errors observed (4× 'Invalid style property of "background"' RN-Web warnings + 1× ElevenLabs 401) are pre-existing and unrelated to this fix.
verification_evidence.cosmetic_p2_fallback_string: Code at line 100 confirms: `BAG NO. — = ${bagCount} BAG${bagCount === 1 ? '' : 'S'}`. Correct. Could not exercise runtime because both test shipments have parseable bag_no ('BAG-1') so the runs branch was taken; the string constant has been code-reviewed and is correct.
